title: Queued native configure failures lose the first CMake source location
body: The queued native boot default-config job failed at /home/liory/.cache/undertow/native-provider-views/kfr-vixen/87cb791c597bb228c2c0/VIXEN/dependencies/native/CMakeLists.txt:60 with the actionable CMake error 'VIXEN: Gaia source revision mismatch: declared a2e62491b56a8589c31da97128f0658088050a70, fetched cde38e70c3c11f2cb4f68556b296407633bcabb4'. The live wrapper instead reported diagnostic_origin=unavailable, diagnostic_location=queue:queue/with-test-lock.sh, diagnostic_log_line=0 and required a manual log hunt. The queue should preserve the first CMake source path:line, item, and a one-line pin-refresh fix in its failure summary; clarity tier haiku because the payload already emitted the location.
